a41c5b7b18.en: A read of ICLR 2026 through one lens: as AI shifts from single models to tool-using agents, the field's attention is moving from chasing benchmark scores to making agents reliable — so they behave well over long, messy, real-world tasks. These are the papers that show where agents break and how to make them trustworthy.
a41c5b7b18.zh: 从一个视角解读 ICLR 2026：随着 AI 从单一模型转向使用工具的智能体，该领域的关注点正从追逐基准测试分数转向让智能体可靠，使其在漫长、混乱的真实任务中表现良好。这些论文展示了智能体在哪里出问题，以及如何让它们值得信赖。

49a6b10bc4.en: {1}Also:{/1} 6 invited speakers · 6 parallel tracks · 40 workshops · 21 socials · 2 Outstanding Paper awards, 1 honorable mention, 2 Test-of-Time awards.
49a6b10bc4.zh: {1}另外：{/1}6 位特邀演讲者 · 6 个并行分会场 · 40 场研讨会 · 21 场社交活动 · 2 篇杰出论文奖、1 篇荣誉提名、2 项时间检验奖。

2d4f971643.en: Outstanding Papers: “Transformers are Inherently Succinct” and “LLMs Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation.” Test of Time: DCGAN; Continuous control with deep RL. The program was dominated by agent evaluation, reliability engineering, safer training, and tool use.
2d4f971643.zh: 杰出论文：“Transformers are Inherently Succinct”和“LLMs Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation”。时间检验奖：DCGAN；Continuous control with deep RL。会议议程以智能体评估、可靠性工程、更安全的训练和工具使用为主。

5c038dfb49.en: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?
5c038dfb49.zh: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?

dfd5b19055.en: Find out why systems built from several cooperating LLM agents break, and sort the failures into a clear map.
dfd5b19055.zh: 找出由多个协作的大语言模型智能体构成的系统为何出错，并把这些失败整理成一张清晰的图谱。

782c9c5aad.en: Multi-agent setups often fail, but teams had no shared way to name or diagnose what actually went wrong.
782c9c5aad.zh: 多智能体方案经常失败，但各团队缺乏一种共同的方式来命名或诊断究竟哪里出了问题。

f8c09f1db8.zh: 研究了大量真实的多智能体运行记录

a2a65af294.en: Built MAST, the first failure taxonomy (14 modes)
a2a65af294.zh: 构建了 MAST，首个失败分类体系（14 种模式）

15c10d886f.en: Grouped them: bad design, agents miscommunicating, weak checking/stopping
15c10d886f.zh: 将它们归为三类：设计不当、智能体之间沟通不畅、检查/终止机制薄弱

d8b7069e51.en: First systematic failure map for multi-agent LLMs. Most failures come from how agents are organized — not from the model being weak.
d8b7069e51.zh: 首个针对多智能体大语言模型的系统性失败图谱。大多数失败源于智能体的组织方式，而不是模型能力弱。

82f91a3c03.en: Over 44% of failures happen during execution. Fix system design — clear roles, real coordination and verification — before adding more agents or bigger models.
82f91a3c03.zh: 超过 44% 的失败发生在执行阶段。应先修正系统设计——明确的角色、真正的协调与验证——再考虑增加智能体或使用更大的模型。

efe7f65c10.en: Workflow for building the MAST failure-mode dataset — identify failures, develop the taxonomy, refine with annotators.
efe7f65c10.zh: 构建 MAST 失败模式数据集的工作流——识别失败、制定分类体系、与标注者一起完善。

2d1fd7db5e.en: LLMs Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation{1} — Outstanding Paper{/1}
2d1fd7db5e.zh: LLMs Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation{1} — 杰出论文{/1}

8d98a0ac20.en: Measure how well LLMs hold up across a back-and-forth conversation, not just one well-written prompt.
8d98a0ac20.zh: 衡量大语言模型在来回多轮对话中的表现，而不只是面对一个写得好的提示词时的表现。

c9ac49febe.en: Real users reveal what they want gradually, but most tests use a single fully-specified prompt — hiding this weakness.
c9ac49febe.zh: 真实用户是逐步表达需求的，但大多数测试只用一个完整给定的提示词——掩盖了这一弱点。

264fd53d1a.zh: 运行了 200,000+ 次模拟多轮对话

c4f71a74ca.en: A user-simulator talks to the model across 6 task types
c4f71a74ca.zh: 由用户模拟器在 6 类任务上与模型对话

9832af7f5c.en: Split the score into skill vs. reliability
9832af7f5c.zh: 把得分拆分为能力与可靠性

196d41db6c.en: Shows a large, consistent drop — about 39% — once a task is spread over several turns. Models lock onto an early guess and can’t recover.
196d41db6c.zh: 显示一旦任务分散到多轮，表现会出现大幅且一致的下降——约 39%。模型会锁定早期的猜测而无法纠正。

06ad5631e4.en: Don’t trust single-prompt benchmarks for assistants. Build for underspecified, multi-turn use: let the model re-ground, revisit assumptions and self-correct.
06ad5631e4.zh: 不要信任针对助手的单提示词基准测试。要面向需求不完整的多轮使用场景来构建：让模型重新建立共识、重审假设并自我纠正。

bf499c8a99.en: Single- vs multi-turn conversations across six tasks — the 15 tested LLMs do far worse multi-turn (−35%).
bf499c8a99.zh: 六项任务上的单轮与多轮对话对比——被测的 15 个大语言模型在多轮下表现差得多 (−35%)。

ca972ebfb4.en: {1}Zhuofeng Li et al.{/1} · Stanford, UC San Diego, Texas A&M, Lambda
ca972ebfb4.zh: {1}Zhuofeng Li et al.{/1} · Stanford, UC San Diego, Texas A&M, Lambda

d41bdfc6f2.en: Train an agent to plan and use tools better while it is actually running the task — not only beforehand.
d41bdfc6f2.zh: 训练智能体在实际执行任务的过程中更好地规划和使用工具，而不只是事先训练。

5a7997150f.en: Most tool-using agents train one policy on the whole context. That fails on long tasks where it is hard to tell which step caused success or failure.
5a7997150f.zh: 大多数使用工具的智能体在整个上下文上训练一个策略。这在长任务上行不通，因为很难判断是哪一步导致了成功或失败。

3d2c09ec4f.en: Splits the agent into Planner, Executor, Verifier, Generator sharing memory
3d2c09ec4f.zh: 把智能体拆分为共享记忆的 Planner、Executor、Verifier、Generator

e5bf76fb84.en: Trains the planner live with Flow-GRPO
e5bf76fb84.zh: 用 Flow-GRPO 在线训练规划器

19848dbb16.en: Spreads the final success/failure signal back to every step
19848dbb16.zh: 把最终的成功/失败信号回传给每一步

5462b4bc52.en: On-policy learning inside the multi-turn loop solves credit assignment. A 7B model beats much larger ones (incl. GPT-4o-level) on 10 benchmarks.
5462b4bc52.zh: 在多轮循环内进行同策略学习，解决了信用分配问题。一个 7B 模型在 10 项基准测试上击败了大得多的模型（包括 GPT-4o 级别）。

7c476c5b51.en: Strong evidence that good system design beats raw model size. Points to ‘agent-as-a-service’ built from small, trainable, modular agents.
7c476c5b51.zh: 有力证明了好的系统设计胜过单纯的模型规模。指向由小型、可训练、模块化的智能体构建的“智能体即服务”。

ff561531f4.en: Case study — after Flow-GRPO training, AgentFlow explores a new solution path where it had been stuck in error loops.
ff561531f4.zh: 案例研究——经过 Flow-GRPO 训练后，AgentFlow 探索出新的解题路径，而此前它困在错误循环中。

e5db777042.en: TAPE: Tool-Guided Adaptive Planning & Constrained Execution
e5db777042.zh: TAPE: Tool-Guided Adaptive Planning & Constrained Execution

4a0ee1f684.en: {1}Jongwon Jeong, Jungtaek Kim, Kangwook Lee{/1} · University of Wisconsin–Madison
4a0ee1f684.zh: {1}Jongwon Jeong, Jungtaek Kim, Kangwook Lee{/1} · University of Wisconsin–Madison

d865f3a8ba.en: Make tool-using agents reliable where a single wrong move can ruin the whole task.
d865f3a8ba.zh: 让使用工具的智能体在一步走错就可能毁掉整个任务的场景中保持可靠。

484cdb92cd.en: Two failure types compound in strict settings: bad plans (invalid action sequences) and random slips while executing.
484cdb92cd.zh: 在严格场景中两类失败会叠加：糟糕的计划（无效的动作序列）和执行时的随机失误。

1c81636b97.en: Builds several candidate plans into a plan-graph
1c81636b97.zh: 把多个候选计划构建成一张计划图

24f1fa14f6.en: An external solver picks a feasible path
24f1fa14f6.zh: 由外部求解器选出一条可行路径

7e03739e42.en: Constrained decoding removes random slips; re-plans on mismatch
7e03739e42.zh: 约束解码消除随机失误；不匹配时重新规划

8b2044ff15.en: Combines multi-plan selection, constrained execution and adaptive re-planning in one loop.
8b2044ff15.zh: 在同一个循环中结合多计划选择、受约束的执行和自适应重新规划。

b4644f2dc5.en: +21 points success rate on hard agent benchmarks — a practical recipe where cost, latency or safety leave no room for error.
b4644f2dc5.zh: 在高难度智能体基准测试上成功率提高 21 个百分点——对于成本、延迟或安全不容出错的场景，这是一套实用方案。

06cb9ffe74.en: Overview on Sokoban — the sources of irrecoverable failure (planning vs sampling errors) in a ReAct agent.
06cb9ffe74.zh: Sokoban 上的概览——ReAct 智能体中不可恢复失败的来源（规划错误与采样错误）。

65b265fd61.en: Atomix: Transactional Tool Use for Reliable Agentic Workflows
65b265fd61.zh: Atomix: Transactional Tool Use for Reliable Agentic Workflows

6d58adf793.en: Stop agents from leaving half-finished or duplicated real-world effects when steps fail or run in parallel.
6d58adf793.zh: 防止智能体在步骤失败或并行运行时，留下做到一半或重复的真实世界影响。

76aa52a028.en: Tool actions (send email, write to a database) are often irreversible. Faults, speculation or multiple agents can leak partial or stale effects.
76aa52a028.zh: 工具操作（发送邮件、写入数据库）往往不可撤销。故障、推测执行或多个智能体可能泄漏部分完成或过期的影响。

fefc24191c.en: A transactional runtime orders work in epochs
fefc24191c.zh: 事务型运行时按 epoch 对工作排序

ee78095092.en: Commits an effect only when no earlier work remains
ee78095092.zh: 只有在没有更早的工作未完成时才提交某项影响

7a4fe258a6.en: Separates reversible vs. external effects; rolls back with compensation
7a4fe258a6.zh: 区分可逆影响与外部影响；通过补偿进行回滚

76a653715c.en: Brings database transaction guarantees — atomic, isolated, recoverable — to LLM tool calls.
76a653715c.zh: 把数据库事务的保证——原子性、隔离性、可恢复性——带给大语言模型的工具调用。

2fa4f393e9.en: Task success under faults jumps from ~0–7% to ~37–57%. Enables safe parallel agents and shared-resource coordination for enterprise automation.
2fa4f393e9.zh: 故障下的任务成功率从约 0–7% 跃升至约 37–57%。为企业自动化实现安全的并行智能体和共享资源协调。

233645b593.en: The Atomix lifecycle across the agent, runtime, and tool layers — effects are sealed and settled transactionally.
233645b593.zh: Atomix 在智能体层、运行时层和工具层上的生命周期——影响被封存并以事务方式结算。

e77dcac58f.en: TROLL: Trust Regions Improve RL for LLMs
e77dcac58f.zh: TROLL: Trust Regions Improve RL for LLMs

d0c773be5b.en: Make reinforcement-learning fine-tuning of LLMs more stable and effective.
d0c773be5b.zh: 让大语言模型的强化学习微调更稳定、更有效。

c2a3575a43.en: The standard ‘PPO clipping’ trick is a rough shortcut: it kills gradients and collapses exploration, so training is unstable and fussy to tune.
c2a3575a43.zh: 标准的“PPO 裁剪”技巧只是一种粗糙的捷径：它会使梯度消失并使探索崩塌，因此训练不稳定，调参也很麻烦。

ebb0b69a8d.en: Replaces clipping with a proper trust-region projection
ebb0b69a8d.zh: 用规范的信任域投影取代裁剪

b927ca5e67.en: Enforces a principled per-token limit on change
b927ca5e67.zh: 对每个 token 的变化施加有原则的限制

2892589008.en: Keeps gradients alive even at the boundary
2892589008.zh: 即使在边界处也保持梯度不消失

6f23225c16.en: A principled objective (not a heuristic) that preserves entropy, so the model keeps exploring.
6f23225c16.zh: 一个有原则的目标（而非启发式方法），可保持熵，使模型持续探索。

c6aadb11fd.en: Faster, more stable training and better reasoning/code results. Trade-off: harder to implement (needs a convex layer and implicit differentiation).
c6aadb11fd.zh: 训练更快、更稳定，推理/代码结果也更好。代价：实现更难（需要凸层和隐式微分）。

cdd2885221.en: TROLL overview — the trust-region projection reshapes the next-token distribution while keeping gradients alive.
cdd2885221.zh: TROLL 概览——信任域投影重塑下一个 token 的分布，同时保持梯度不消失。

5822b1ea94.en: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform RL
5822b1ea94.zh: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform RL

81eb48a6b7.en: {1}Lakshya A Agrawal et al.{/1} · UC Berkeley
81eb48a6b7.zh: {1}Lakshya A Agrawal et al.{/1} · UC Berkeley

e3589ed676.en: Improve an AI system by rewriting its prompts instead of retraining its weights.
e3589ed676.zh: 通过重写提示词来改进 AI 系统，而不是重新训练其权重。

30b62fb6ee.en: RL methods like GRPO need thousands of expensive rollouts to adapt to a new task.
30b62fb6ee.zh: 像 GRPO 这样的 RL 方法需要数千次昂贵的 rollout 才能适应新任务。

6113328222.en: Runs the system and reads its own traces in plain English
6113328222.zh: 运行系统，并用自然语言读取它自己的轨迹

0d330e2afb.en: Diagnoses mistakes, proposes and tests prompt edits
0d330e2afb.zh: 诊断错误，提出并测试提示词修改

79b2bb1736.en: Keeps the best ideas from a Pareto frontier of attempts
79b2bb1736.zh: 从各次尝试的 Pareto 前沿中保留最好的想法

8405b15eab.en: Uses natural-language self-reflection to learn high-level rules — not just numeric rewards.
8405b15eab.zh: 利用自然语言自我反思来学习高层规则，而不只是数值奖励。

802710f885.en: Beats GRPO by up to 20% while using up to 35× fewer rollouts — a cheap, fast alternative to fine-tuning for adapting models per domain.
802710f885.zh: 比 GRPO 最多高出 20%，所用 rollout 最多少 35 倍——是微调之外一种廉价、快速的按领域适配模型的方式。

80772154ef.en: Each GEPA iteration proposes a new candidate via reflective prompt mutation or system-aware merge, kept on a Pareto frontier.
80772154ef.zh: GEPA 的每次迭代通过反思式提示词变异或系统感知合并提出新的候选，并保留在 Pareto 前沿上。

ec0d2a50aa.en: {1}Lechen Zhang et al.{/1} · U. Michigan, UIUC, UIC, LG AI Research
ec0d2a50aa.zh: {1}Lechen Zhang et al.{/1} · U. Michigan, UIUC, UIC, LG AI Research

a28c946482.en: Automatically find a strong general-purpose system prompt that helps across many tasks.
a28c946482.zh: 自动找到一个强大的通用系统提示词，使其在众多任务上都有帮助。

2724b795e2.en: System prompts are usually hand-written. Good ones are hard to discover and rarely transfer.
2724b795e2.zh: 系统提示词通常靠手写。好的提示词很难发现，也很少能迁移。

337c2516b5.en: An edit-based genetic search over prompt components
337c2516b5.zh: 对提示词组件进行基于编辑的遗传搜索

c1f4c262e4.en: Builds prompts from reusable building blocks
c1f4c262e4.zh: 用可复用的构件来构建提示词

18887d11a1.en: Keeps the versions that score best over 47 tasks
18887d11a1.zh: 保留在 47 个任务上得分最高的版本

6d9cf70ad6.en: Optimizes the system prompt (general instructions) rather than tuning a prompt per task.
6d9cf70ad6.zh: 优化系统提示词（通用指令），而不是针对每个任务调整提示词。

cd4c109f2c.en: One optimized system prompt matches per-task tuning; combining both helps more. Cheap gains with no retraining — handy per domain or region.
cd4c109f2c.zh: 一个经过优化的系统提示词可与逐任务调优相当；两者结合收益更大。无需重新训练即可获得低成本的提升——适合按领域或地区使用。

3d5806f734.en: The SPRIG pipeline — reward estimation and elimination, then mutation/heredity operators, then sample-and-evaluate, iterating each generation.
3d5806f734.zh: SPRIG 流水线——奖励估计与淘汰，然后是变异/遗传算子，再是采样与评估，每一代不断迭代。

7770a0bdbb.en: SafeDPO: Preference Optimization with Enhanced Safety
7770a0bdbb.zh: SafeDPO: Preference Optimization with Enhanced Safety

7619867779.en: {1}Geon-Hyeong Kim et al.{/1} · LG AI Research
7619867779.zh: {1}Geon-Hyeong Kim et al.{/1} · LG AI Research

2f5a9ce658.en: Align a model to be both helpful and safe in one simple training step.
2f5a9ce658.zh: 在一个简单的训练步骤中，让模型既有帮助又安全。

71cd4c76c0.en: Safety alignment (safe-RLHF) usually needs separate reward and cost models plus online sampling — complex and unstable.
71cd4c76c0.zh: 安全对齐 (safe-RLHF) 通常需要单独的奖励模型和成本模型，加上在线采样——复杂且不稳定。

33847e2e72.en: Rewrites the safety-constrained goal into one closed-form loss
33847e2e72.zh: 把带安全约束的目标改写为一个闭式损失

950974e687.en: Uses only preference data plus a safety label
950974e687.zh: 只使用偏好数据加一个安全标签

fc6643b34c.en: No reward model, no cost model, no online sampling
fc6643b34c.zh: 无需奖励模型、成本模型和在线采样

7cd51f252e.en: Enforces safety at the objective level, in a single offline stage.
7cd51f252e.zh: 在目标层面、通过单一的离线阶段来保证安全。

25c58ac8fe.en: Competitive safety-vs-helpfulness trade-off with far less machinery — a lightweight, practical path to safe alignment.
25c58ac8fe.zh: 以少得多的机制，实现具有竞争力的安全性与有用性权衡——一条轻量、实用的安全对齐路径。

d21fca1067.en: Safe RLHF (left) vs SafeDPO (right) — SafeDPO drops the separate reward and cost models.
d21fca1067.zh: Safe RLHF（左）与 SafeDPO（右）对比——SafeDPO 去掉了单独的奖励模型和成本模型。

18092078d4.en: Make neural models obey hard rules (physical or operational limits) while also reporting how uncertain they are.
18092078d4.zh: 让神经模型遵守硬性规则（物理或运行上的限制），同时报告自身的不确定程度。

60f48ef808.en: Standard models don’t guarantee constraints. Adding them afterward hurts quality or is unstable at scale.
60f48ef808.zh: 标准模型不保证满足约束。事后再加约束会损害质量，或在大规模下不稳定。

0eada8698e.en: Adds a differentiable projection layer inside the network
0eada8698e.zh: 在网络内部加入一个可微分的投影层

53bab1fe86.en: Constraints are learned end-to-end, not bolted on after
53bab1fe86.zh: 约束是端到端学习的，而不是事后外挂的

64c403c08f.zh: 以概率方式表述预测，以体现不确定性

09fa420de3.en: Builds feasibility into the model’s internal representation rather than filtering outputs after the fact.
09fa420de3.zh: 把可行性构建进模型的内部表示，而不是事后过滤输出。

5a2acabc7e.en: Reliable, rule-respecting predictions that also say how confident they are — valuable for forecasting and safety-critical control.
5a2acabc7e.zh: 可靠、遵守规则的预测，并说明其置信程度——对预测和安全关键控制很有价值。

61f5ae59d1.en: Schematic of ProbHardE2E — a base probabilistic model feeds a differentiable projection layer (DPPL) that enforces the constraints.
61f5ae59d1.zh: ProbHardE2E 示意图——基础概率模型输入到可微分投影层 (DPPL)，由它强制满足约束。

70827db2ca.en: Evaluate the security of agents at the level of their actions, not just the raw model.
70827db2ca.zh: 在智能体的动作层面评估其安全性，而不只是评估原始模型。

7d63109da2.en: Testing the model alone underestimates risk. Agents gain new attack surfaces from tool-calling, memory and multi-step reasoning.
7d63109da2.zh: 只测试模型本身会低估风险。智能体会因工具调用、记忆和多步推理而出现新的攻击面。

fb224e33af.en: AgentSeer breaks a run into action graphs and component graphs
fb224e33af.zh: AgentSeer 把一次运行拆解为动作图和组件图

1aa9ab453e.zh: 精确定位有风险的单个动作

51e22ee222.en: Hardens system prompts with a replay-based loop
51e22ee222.zh: 通过基于回放的循环加固系统提示词

6e08de1a3d.en: Action-level observability reveals ‘agentic-only’ weaknesses invisible at the model level (tool-calling 24–60% higher attack success).
6e08de1a3d.zh: 动作层面的可观测性揭示了模型层面看不到的“仅智能体才有”的弱点（工具调用的攻击成功率高出 24–60%）。

3b9b3a87b3.en: Cut jailbreak success from ~45% to ~8%. Model-level checks aren’t enough — agent products need action-level red-teaming and prompt governance.
3b9b3a87b3.zh: 将越狱成功率从约 45% 降至约 8%。仅做模型层面的检查是不够的——智能体产品需要动作层面的红队测试和提示词治理。

9d4d00391f.en: The hierarchical 6-agent testbed used for evaluation, showing typical multi-agent coordination patterns.
9d4d00391f.zh: 用于评估的分层 6 智能体测试平台，展示了典型的多智能体协调模式。

5c9095da28.en: Asymmetric Goal Drift in Coding Agents
5c9095da28.zh: Asymmetric Goal Drift in Coding Agents

1b4c9e7305.en: Test whether coding agents quietly stop following their instructions over a long task.
1b4c9e7305.zh: 测试编程智能体在长任务中是否会悄悄不再遵守其指令。

f208253929.en: An agent may obey at first but ‘drift’ from its system prompt as work piles up — especially when the rule clashes with its own strong values.
f208253929.zh: 智能体起初可能服从，但随着工作量堆积会逐渐偏离其系统提示词——尤其是当规则与它自身的强烈价值观冲突时。

ef46781d40.en: Used the OpenCode agent on multi-step coding tasks
ef46781d40.zh: 让 OpenCode 智能体执行多步骤编程任务

71b8a5fdfd.en: Added constraints on privacy, security and efficiency
71b8a5fdfd.zh: 加入了关于隐私、安全和效率的约束

b9ad06d678.en: Watched for violations over long runs
b9ad06d678.zh: 在长时间运行中观察是否出现违规

3e84dd77df.en: Finds asymmetric drift: models break rules more when the rule opposes values they hold strongly; repo comments can even override the system prompt.
3e84dd77df.zh: 发现了不对称偏移：当规则与模型强烈持有的价值观相悖时，模型更容易违反规则；代码仓库中的注释甚至可以压过系统提示词。

379c976169.en: Initial compliance checks aren’t enough. Coding / DevOps agents need long-horizon drift monitoring and repo-level, environment-aware security controls.
379c976169.zh: 仅做初始合规检查是不够的。编程/DevOps 智能体需要长周期偏移监控，以及代码仓库层面、感知环境的安全控制。

c2debed357.en: The coding-agent goal-drift evaluation framework and how accumulating adversarial pressure drives violations.
c2debed357.zh: 编程智能体目标偏移的评估框架，以及不断累积的对抗压力如何导致违规。

f578df729a.en: Reliability — not peak accuracy — is the new scoreboard for agents.
f578df729a.zh: 可靠性——而不是峰值准确率——是智能体的新计分板。

24abd64aa1.en: Most agent failures come from system design and coordination, not weak models.
24abd64aa1.zh: 大多数智能体的失败源于系统设计和协调，而不是模型能力弱。

20fbc5541b.en: Small, well-designed modular agents can beat much larger single models.
20fbc5541b.zh: 设计良好的小型模块化智能体可以胜过大得多的单一模型。

6653bbcb09.en: Benchmarks shift from scoring models to scoring whole agent pipelines.
6653bbcb09.zh: 基准测试从给模型打分转向给整条智能体流水线打分。

cadeb9e2fe.en: Training moves in-loop (live) and safety/constraints move into the objective.
cadeb9e2fe.zh: 训练转为循环内（在线）进行，安全/约束则进入目标函数。

253b1b3976.en: Tool use gets database-style guarantees; prompts get optimized automatically.
253b1b3976.zh: 工具使用获得数据库式的保证；提示词被自动优化。

8072fc71ab.en: Prioritize agent system design, verification and execution reliability.
8072fc71ab.zh: 优先关注智能体系统设计、验证和执行可靠性。

ecd3dfa800.en: Add action-level red-teaming and long-horizon drift monitoring to agent products.
ecd3dfa800.zh: 为智能体产品加入动作层面的红队测试和长周期偏移监控。

a8c49dee12.en: Prefer cheap adaptation (reflective prompts, optimized system prompts) over retraining.
a8c49dee12.zh: 优先选择低成本的适配方式（反思式提示词、优化的系统提示词），而不是重新训练。

42da34276e.en:
Insights

  • Reliability — not peak accuracy — is the new scoreboard for agents.
  • Most agent failures come from system design and coordination, not weak models.
  • Small, well-designed modular agents can beat much larger single models.

Vision

  • Benchmarks shift from scoring models to scoring whole agent pipelines.
  • Training moves in-loop (live) and safety/constraints move into the objective.
  • Tool use gets database-style guarantees; prompts get optimized automatically.

Implications for us

  • Prioritize agent system design, verification and execution reliability.
  • Add action-level red-teaming and long-horizon drift monitoring to agent products.
  • Prefer cheap adaptation (reflective prompts, optimized system prompts) over retraining.
42da34276e.zh:
洞察

  • 可靠性，而非峰值准确率，是智能体的新计分板。
  • 大多数智能体故障源于系统设计和协调，而不是模型能力弱。
  • 设计良好的小型模块化智能体可以胜过大得多的单一模型。

愿景

  • 基准测试从给模型打分转向给整条智能体流水线打分。
  • 训练转入循环内（在线）进行，安全与约束进入训练目标。
  • 工具使用获得数据库式的保证；提示词实现自动优化。

对我们的启示

  • 优先关注智能体系统设计、验证和执行可靠性。
  • 为智能体产品加入动作级红队测试和长程漂移监控。
  • 优先选择低成本的适应方式（反思式提示词、优化后的系统提示词），而不是重新训练。

c85557a3a3.en: Splits the agent into Planner, Executor, Verifier, Generator sharing memory · Trains the planner live with Flow-GRPO · Spreads the final success/failure signal back to every step

40d3f58562.zh: Jongwon Jeong, Jungtaek Kim, Kangwook Lee · University of Wisconsin–Madison

b44fb69cce.en: Builds several candidate plans into a plan-graph · An external solver picks a feasible path · Constrained decoding removes random slips; re-plans on mismatch
b44fb69cce.zh: 把多个候选计划构建成计划图 · 由外部求解器选出可行路径 · 约束解码消除随机失误；不匹配时重新规划

f885c7e6fc.zh: 洞察 05 · 可靠的规划、工具与执行

ef10f57c7d.en: A transactional runtime orders work in epochs · Commits an effect only when no earlier work remains · Separates reversible vs. external effects; rolls back with compensation
ef10f57c7d.zh: 事务式运行时按时间段（epoch）对工作排序 · 仅当没有更早的工作遗留时才提交效果 · 区分可逆效果与外部效果；通过补偿回滚

cba9811d4f.en: Replaces clipping with a proper trust-region projection · Enforces a principled per-token limit on change · Keeps gradients alive even at the boundary
cba9811d4f.zh: 用规范的信任域投影取代裁剪 · 对每个 token 的变化施加有原则的限制 · 即使在边界处也保持梯度有效
